definitions.explanation: A fabric made by bonding or felting fibers together rather than weaving them. Used in surgical masks, wet wipes, cleaning cloths, filters, and disposable products.

examples.japanese: {不織布|ふしょくふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけている→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm wearing a non-woven fabric mask.

examples.japanese: ⟦ウェットティッシュ→ウェットティッシュ：25028_wettotisshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不織布|ふしょくふ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Wet wipes are made of non-woven fabric.

examples.japanese: {不織布|ふしょくふ}⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{飛沫|ひまつ}→飛沫：29069_himatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Non-woven masks are said to be more effective at blocking droplets than cloth masks.

notes:
Composed of {不|ふ} (not) + {織|しょく} (weave) + {布|ふ} (cloth). Literally "non-woven cloth". Became a familiar everyday word in Japan through coverage of mask materials during the COVID-19 pandemic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不織布|ふしょくふ}⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧: non-woven fabric mask
- {不織布|ふしょくふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧: non-woven sheet
- {不織布|ふしょくふ}⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of non-woven fabric

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{織物|おりもの}→織物：10583_orimono⟧: woven fabric — the contrasting category, made by interlacing threads on a loom
- ⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧: cloth, fabric — generic term that includes both woven and non-woven types
